local-coder.description: Local coding agent. Uses Ollama qwen2.5-coder:7b for self-contained Go tasks: boilerplate, simple features, test stubs. No network. Fast and private.
local-coder.prompt:
@.opencode/system-prompt-local.md

You are a Go coding assistant for the sdp_lab project. Follow the rules above exactly. Write complete, compilable code only.

local-fast.description: Minimal local agent. Uses deepseek-coder:6.7b for autocomplete-style tasks: function stubs, docstrings, simple refactors. Smallest model, fastest responses.
local-fast.prompt:
@.opencode/system-prompt-local.md

You are a fast Go code completion assistant. Return only the requested code fragment. No explanations unless asked.

builder.description: TDD execution agent. Implements workstreams following Red-Green-Refactor cycle.
builder.prompt: See @prompts/commands/build.md for full TDD workflow and execution report template

reviewer.description: Code review agent. Performs 17-point quality checks for workstreams.

planner.description: Planning agent. Analyzes requirements and creates workstream specifications.
